notes.comparison: Original generated C++ versus the optimized generated-code prototype. The native generator port emits equivalent function bodies for every generated solver-corpus game.
notes.build: MSVC x64 Release, O2, no link-time optimization, same native runtime libraries
notes.timing: Two runs per version in before/after/after/before order; arithmetic means. No compilation ran during the timed benchmark.
notes.solutionValidation: Independent native interpreter with all generated backends disabled. All 14 replay disagreements reproduced with baseline solutions, including an additional 2-second baseline solve for Match-Maker level 17. These remain pre-existing failures, not passes.
notes.interpretation: Timeout-heavy wall time is mostly fixed; throughput and identical-work timings are more useful. Per-game differences from two samples need targeted confirmation; the Cakemonsters slowdown was not reproduced in the recorded follow-up.
